title: Private Underground Toronto PATH Tour
includes: Hotel pick up and drop off (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Have you ever wanted to explore an underground city? Toronto has the largest underground shopping complex and over 30 kilometers (19 miles) of walkways in the world that connects many of Toronto's most important and historic sites. Take a tour of this lesser explored underbelly of Toronto's downtown district. 95% of the tour is indoors, so recommended during those cold winter months!
